records.section_heading: Slow-moving waves of polyp retraction traverse Porites lobata mounds
records.question: What was the average rate at which the bands of retracted polyps moved across Porites lobata mounds?
records.ground_truth_answer: They moved at an average rate of 0.55 cm/h (SD = 0.15), equivalent to 13 cm/day.
ground_truth_chunks: These bands moved across the *Porites* mounds at an average rate of 0.55 cm/h (SD = 0.15) or 13 cm/day.

At that rate, it would take approximately 17 days to completely traverse the average size of the hemispherical *Porites* mounds in the study area (average = 425-cm base circumference, 80-cm height, 220-cm dome curvature).
